How it learns

How the model learns

STEP 1
Train on the past only
STEP 2
Forecast the next months
STEP 3
Compare with what happened
STEP 4
Move forward one month ↻
NOW · 1-12 months aheadMachine learning (LightGBM) on lake level, GRACE, rain, soil and El Niño. Retrained each year on past data only.
+
NEXT · 6-18 months aheadA water balance that replays the 11 past El Niño seasons. Probability = how many end below 10%.
Blended by lead time · Brier skill 0 at 3 months, 2000-2026
Strictly forward back-test, data as published at the time · blend weight min(1, h/6) · kariba.json, reservoirs.json

Patronus caught Lake Kariba, Zambia, 5 months early

Caught 5 months early

Alarm Jul 2023 → water cut Dec 2023 → blackouts Mar 2024
We replayed 17 past crises: Patronus caught 14.

Proof

The 3 we missed, and why

Kariba 2015Peak probability 0.45El Niño hit a lake that still looked normal for the season.
Kariba 2019Probability 0.50; the alarm needs more than 0.50A weak El Niño. Missed by a hair.
Tarbela 2025Pakistan · lake at its 48th percentileIt reaches dead level every spring by design.
Next version: an El Niño trigger for lakes that still look fullplus a dead-level test for lakes that are drawn down every year, like Tarbela.
14 of 17 caught · all 3 misses are published on the site
Reservoir watch back-test, 2000-2026, data as published at the time · docs/RESERVOIRS.md, reservoirs.json
